# eon_backup_posture_controls (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of backup posture controls in the Eon project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Retrieve all backup posture controls in the project
data "eon_backup_posture_controls" "all" {}

output "high_severity_controls" {
  value = [
    for control in data.eon_backup_posture_controls.all.controls :
    control.name if control.severity == "HIGH"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `controls` (Attributes List) List of backup posture controls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controls))

<a id="nestedatt--controls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `controls`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Backup posture control ID.
- `name` (String) Backup posture control display name.
- `resource_selection_mode` (String) Mode that determines how resources are selected for the control. Possible values: `ALL`, `CONDITIONAL`.
- `severity` (String) Severity reported when a resource violates the control. Possible values: `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`.
